name: Recital R
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2025
part_text: whereas the climate crisis poses a threat to humanity as a whole and is, at its core, a human rights crisis, undermining the rights to life, food, water and sanitation, health, culture and beyond in every region of the world, as recognised by the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) and the UN Human Rights Council;
